messages.party_question: Great! How many people will attend, including you? (1 to {max})
messages.diet_other_question: Please type the requirement, for example nut allergy.
messages.wheelchair_question: Does anyone in your party use a wheelchair?
messages.wheelchair_count_question: How many people in your party use a wheelchair? (1 to {max})
messages.note_question: Anything else we should know, for example a step-free route or accessible parking? Tap Skip or type your note.
messages.declined: Sorry you can't make it, thanks for letting us know. Reply CHANGE if your plans change.
messages.already_declined: We have you down as not attending.
messages.restart_ack: No problem, let's update your RSVP.
messages.opted_out: You won't receive any more messages about this event.
messages.help_ack: Thanks, we've let the organiser know. Someone will get back to you.

messages.invalid_choice: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Please choose one of the options.
messages.invalid_number: Please reply with a number from 1 to {max}.
messages.invalid_too_long: Please keep it to {max} characters or fewer.
messages.change_not_yet: You can reply CHANGE once you've finished answering.

messages.reminder_unfinished: Just a reminder to finish your RSVP for {event} on {date}. Here's where we got to:
